rules.text: R1: Check the weapon before every skill; skip a skill whose weapon does not match the equipped weapon (Power Smash = SWORD/BLUNT, Whirlwind = POLE, Triple Slash = DUAL: a dual sword is NOT "SWORD", Backstab = DAGGER/DUALDAGGER, Double Shot = BOW).
R2: Toggles only in fights (owner rule 2026-10-10): every stance drains MP per tick (ConsumeMpByLevel).
R3: Monsters never hit CP; CP-only skills are PvP-only (Braveheart 440 +1000 CP, Wrath 320 CP drain).
R4: Skills that eat a corpse (ConsumeBody: Life Scavenge 46, Corpse Plague 103) never run in a party with a spoiler: they destroy the corpse before Sweeper.

R5: Target-cancel skills never on the tank's own monster (the tank never uses them on what it tanks; damage dealers may): Shield Slam 353, Shock Blast 361, Earthquake 347, Shock Stomp 452, Stun Shot 101, Bluff 358, Shadow Step 821.

R6: Item-cost skills only when the item is in the bag, never "just because it's ready": Sonic Buster 9 / Sonic Storm 7 = 3 Energy Stones (5589); Symbols 454/457/458/459/460 = 1 Battle Symbol (8875); Soul of the Phoenix 438 = Phoenix Blood (8873); Dark Panther 283 = Crystal D (1459); Quiver 323/324 and Summon Treasure Key 419 need crystals and free bag room.

R7: Watch the HP cost; do not cast below ~40 % HP (except emergency skills): Earthquake 347 = 340 HP, Shock Blast 361 = 507, Sonic Rage 345 = 50, Sonic Focus 8 = 25, Soul of Sagittarius 303 = 364, Pain of Sagittarius 417 = 407, Touch of Life 341 = 1215, Touch of Death 342 = 669, Sacrifice 69 = 1560.

R8: Same-slot buffs replace each other; keep only one. DETECT_WEAKNESS: Detect Insect/Animal/Plant/Beast/Dragon Weakness 75/87/104/80/88, Eye of Hunter 359, Eye of Slayer 360. FOCUS_DAGGER: Focus Chance 356, Focus Power 357. MD_UP: Iron Will 72 and the board's Magic Barrier.
R9: Transformation = never: Vanguard 810 (Paladin) / 811 (Dark Avenger) is a 6 h transformation that swaps the whole skill bar and halves shield defence.
R10: Self-root skills (Ultimate Defense 110, Vengeance 368, Snipe 313) only while the character is meant to stand still; never while the team walks or the archer kites.
R11: PvP-only skills = never in PvE: Mirage 445 (only vs L2Playable), Detection 933 (removes Hide), Touch of Death 342, Wrath 320, Braveheart 440.

Board buffs last 12 h: self-buffs the board already gives are left out; party buffs such as Haste, Might, Shield and dances are ignored. Self-buffs in the same abnormal slot as a board buff are marked "skip with board buffs".

H5 tree file (highFiveNewClassSkillTree.xml) adds: Sonic Mastery 992 (Gladiator/Duelist passive, not in the class .md files), Weapon Blockade 775 (Duelist 80), Shield Strike 984 (Paladin + Dark Avenger 40-74, Phoenix + Hell Knight 76-85), Challenge for Fate 985 (Phoenix + Hell Knight 83), Multiple Shot 987 (Sagittarius 82), Death Shot 990 (Sagittarius 83), Throwing Dagger 991 (Adventurer 80), Dual Blow 928 (Adventurer 83). Dreadnought gets nothing new. Triple Sonic Slash 261 is in the main tree (Gladiator 55-74).

Rush Impact (793 ancient sword / 995; lineage2wiki: Duelist 83, Dreadnought 83) and Rush 994 (la2era: Warlord) are in neither tree file: use them only if the live get_account_data type=skills shows them; left out of the rotations.
Forgotten-scroll skills (Final Secret, Hide, Dread Pool, Shield Bash ...) are in no class tree: out of scope.

Uncertain / check live: Rush / Rush Impact on L2Toggle; whether Focus Skill Mastery 334 and Vicious Stance 312 run together; Weapon Blockade 775 on raid bosses; Touch of Death 342 value on bosses; Veil 106 breaking on damage; whether the board's "All Buffs" scheme carries a MAX_HP_UP buff (Bless the Body) that would block Battle Roar 121.

0.name: Human Fighter
notes: Base table §1, the same for all six lines.
Levels 1-4: auto-attack only (no attack skill yet), any weapon.
AoE / toggles / buffs: none in this band.

Weapon choice by future line: Duelist / Dreadnought / knights: sword (knights + shield) → Power Strike. Adventurer: dagger → Mortal Blow. Sagittarius: bow → Power Shot. Pick the skill from the EQUIPPED weapon (R1).
Party role: everyone is a melee/ranged DD. The future knight can already hold monsters with its sword + shield, but has no aggro skill until 24.

rows.name: Power Strike
rows.trigger: Spam on cooldown (3 s, 17 MP).

rows.name: Mortal Blow
rows.trigger: Spam (3 s, 30 MP). It's a blow (blowChance 20): it lands more often from the side or behind.

rows.name: Power Shot
rows.trigger: Opener from range, then on cooldown (6 s, 67 MP: heavy MP for level 5-19, keep it as the opener only).
rows.why: Guide aspect: single target; its rule makes it the opener only (MP cost).
